SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTRY.
File No. D 4546

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.

Special Branch. S. / 28 / 33
REPORT
Date March 6, 1933.

Subject (in full) Zung Zau Chien (陳少) wanted by the Chinese
Authorities for Communist activities.

Made by D. S. Umemoto. Forwarded by [签名]

In accordance with the instructions of the Officer i/c
Special Branch, I have to report that the case of arrest and
subsequent release of Zung Zau Chien (陳少銓), Formosan,
on February 23, 1933, was duly communicated to Mr. Akagi, Consul
i/c Intelligence Section of the local Japanese Consular Police
Department, who expressed the following opinion in connection
with this matter:-

Zung Zau Chien, being registered at the Consulate as
a Formosan, should be brought before the Japanese Consular Court
in case he is arrested by the Municipal Police provided they
have sufficient evidence to prove his Communist activities.
No protest, however, will be lodged over any action taken by
the Police against this individual as a Chinese prior to his
being identified as a Formosan. If any trouble arise between
the Chinese Authorities concerning his nationality the matter
will be taken up by the Japanese Consul for direct negotiation
with the Chinese Authorities.

[签名]
D. S.

Officer i/c Special Branch.

Supt. Ian,
Please inform
Chinese authorities.
[签名]
9.3.33

Instruction complies with
Ian 9/3/33
MAR 9 1933

上海工部局警务处
政治部登记处
档案编号 D 4546

上海工部局警务处

政治部 S. / 28 / 33
报告
日期：1933年3月6日

事由（全称）：因从事共产主义活动被中国当局通缉的陈少（Zung Zau Chien）。

呈报人：副督察梅本（D. S. Umemoto）。转呈人：[签名]

根据政治部主管官员的指示，我现呈报如下：关于1933年2月23日逮捕并随后释放台湾人陈少铨（Zung Zau Chien）一案，已正式通报给当地日本领事馆警察署情报科主管领事赤木先生，他对此事表达了以下意见：

陈少铨在领事馆登记为台湾人，如果工部局警察将其逮捕，且有足够证据证明其从事共产主义活动，则应将其移送日本领事法庭。然而，在确认其台湾人身份之前，警察将其作为中国人采取的任何行动，日方均不会提出抗议。如果中国当局对其国籍问题产生任何争议，将由日本领事直接与中国当局交涉。

[签名]
D. S.

政治部主管官员。

严警司（Supt. Ian）：
请告知
中国当局。
[签名]
33年3月9日

指令已照办
严（Ian） 9/3/33
1933年3月9日

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT
File No. S. B. REGISTRY.
N. D 4546
Special Branch, S.2 Station, J P.3
Date March 1, 1933

Subject (in full) Zung Zau Chien (陳少) wanted by the Chinese
Authorities for being a communist.

Made by D.I. Kuh Peo-hwa Forwarded by [签名]

With reference to the endorsement of the
Officer i/c Special Branch on the attached file on the
arrest and subsequent release of Zung Zau Chien (陳少銓)
residing at No.206 Tong Shing Lee (東興里) off Avenue
Foch on February 23, 1933, I forward herewith together
with translation a statement made by Woo Tien (胡天) at
present detained by the Chinese Authorities, in connection
with the allegation that Zung Zau Chien is a communist.
The statement was obtained through Superintendent Tan from
the Public Safety Bureau.

It will be recalled that Zung Zau Chien was
arrested under the name of Sung Hai Tien (陳海天) at
8.10 a.m. November 17, 1932 as he was entering House No.49,
Lane 66, Oong Foh Li (鴻福里), Sinza Road, a communist
base which had been raided by the Police and where a watch
was being maintained. It was then ascertained that Zung
was registered at the local Japanese Consulate but
proceedings were discontinued on the ground of insufficiency
of evidence. In connection with this case, Mr. Tajima,
Assistant Commissioner (Japanese), expressed the opinion
that possession of communist literature was not offence
under Japanese Law.

[签名]
Kuh Peo-hwa
D. I.

Officer i/c Special Branch.
S2.
Please bring the facts to the attention
of Mr. Abrahams and report what he advises. [签名]
DS. Uncontd. as indicated. SB Reps 2:8:33

上海工部局警务处
报告
档案编号：政治部登记处
N. D 4546
政治部，S.2捕房，J P.3
日期：1933年3月1日

事由（全称）：因系共产党员被中国当局通缉的陈少（Zung Zau Chien）。

呈报人：副督察顾宝华（D.I. Kuh Peo-hwa）。转呈人：[签名]

关于政治部主管官员在随附档案上的批示，涉及1933年2月23日对居住在福煦路（Avenue Foch）外东兴里206号的陈少铨（Zung Zau Chien）的逮捕及随后释放一事，现随文附上目前被中国当局羁押的胡天（Woo Tien）的一份陈述书及其译文，内容涉及指控陈少铨为共产党员的情况。该陈述书是经由谭警司从公安局获得的。

众所周知，陈少铨曾于1932年11月17日上午8时10分以“陈海天”（Sung Hai Tien）之名被捕，当时他正进入新闸路（Sinza Road）鸿福里66弄49号，该处是已被警方搜查并处于监视下的共产党据点。当时查明陈某在当地日本领事馆有登记，但因证据不足而停止了诉讼程序。关于此案，助理处长（日籍）田岛先生曾表示，根据日本法律，持有共产主义文献并不构成犯罪。

[签名]
顾宝华
副督察

政治部主管官员。
S2。
请将事实告知亚伯拉罕先生（Mr. Abrahams）并报告其建议。[签名]
DS。未完，如注。政治部报告 2:8:33

page_data.en:
Translation of a statement of Woo Tien(胡天)
at present in custody of the Chinese Authorities
on a charge of propagating Communism.

Woo Tien, native of Hupeh, age 25, residing at
5th house, 3rd lane, Foh Tuh Faung(福德坊), Hart
Road, Shanghai;

Question: When did you come to Shanghai?
Answer : In the 16th year of the Republic of China(1927).
Question: What did you do immediately after your
arrival?
Answer : I worked in the Andersen Meyer & Co. for a
short period and then went to Shantung.
Question: How long have you been in the Communist Party?
Answer : About 5 years or more.
Question: What communist activities did you undertake
during the five years?
Answer : I worked as Clerk of the Chefoo City Committee
of the Communist Party; Reporter of the Red
Flag Newspaper of the Shanghai Communist Party;
Chief of the Publication Department of the said
communist publication; and lastly Chief of the
Publication Department of the Kiangsu
Provincial Committee.
Question: Who are the communists that have connections
with you in Shanghai?
Answer : Zung Zao Zien(陈兆全 ), Zee Seu Zung(徐守成),
Zia Choh Tsai(谢觉哉 ), and Lau Jui (老翟 ).
Question: What work are they undertaking in the Party?
Answer : Zung Zao Zien is a journalist; Zee Seu Zung,
publicator; Zia Choh Tsai, Editor; Lau Jui, in
charge of printing works.
Question: Zung Zao Zien is reported to be a Formosan.
Do you know that?
page_data.zh:
目前因涉嫌宣传共产主义被中国当局羁押的胡天（Woo Tien）的陈述书译文。

胡天，湖北人，现年25岁，住上海赫德路（Hart Road）福德坊3弄5号；

问：你什么时候来上海的？
答：民国十六年（1927年）。
问：你到上海后立即做了什么？
答：我在慎昌洋行（Andersen Meyer & Co.）工作了一短时间，然后去了山东。
问：你入党多久了？
答：大约5年或更久。
问：这五年间你从事了哪些共产主义活动？
答：我曾任共产党烟台市委文书；上海共产党《红旗报》记者；该共产党刊物出版部主任；最后担任江苏省委出版部主任。
问：在上海与你有联系的共产党员有哪些？
答：陈兆全（Zung Zao Zien）、徐守成（Zee Seu Zung）、谢觉哉（Zia Choh Tsai）和老翟（Lau Jui）。
问：他们在党内从事什么工作？
答：陈兆全是记者；徐守成负责出版；谢觉哉是编辑；老翟负责印刷工作。
问：据报陈兆全是台湾人。你知道吗？

page_data.en:
-2-

Answer : Zung Zao Zien is actually a Chinese. I
have had connections with him for more than
three years and I know him very well.

Question:Where is his home?
Answer: In Ningpo.

Question:Is Zung Zao Zien married?
Answer :Yes, he is married. His wife is also a
native of Ningpo.

Question:Where is his wife living?
Answer :It is reported that she has removed
from Ningpo to Shanghai.

Question:Has Zung Zao Zien ever been arrested?
Answer :He was arrested once during last year (1932).

(Signed) Woo Tien.
February 27th, 1933.
page_data.zh:
-2-

答：陈兆全实际上是中国人。我与他联系了三年多，我很了解他。

问：他的家乡在哪里？
答：在宁波。

问：陈兆全结婚了吗？
答：是的，他结婚了。他的妻子也是宁波人。

问：他的妻子住在哪里？
答：据报她已从宁波搬到了上海。

问：陈兆全曾被捕过吗？
答：他在去年（1932年）被捕过一次。

（签名）胡天。
1933年2月27日。

Safety Bureau.            Feb. 23rd,       33.

1.

At 8.45 p.m. 23-2-33 acting upon the authority
of Special District Court Warrants, numbers 6978/9,
issued by Judge Fung, at the request of the Public Safety
Bureau, D.S.I. Bennett, D.S. Tchourakhanaky, and party
of detectives, accompanied by Wong Yung Chuan (王美俊)
P.S.B. raided, premises 209 Tong Shing Lee, (東兴里) off
Avenue Poch, in an endeavour to arrest one, Tung Tau
Chien (陳少館) wanted by the Chinese Authorities for
being a Communist.

This man Tung Tau Chien is implicated by a male
Chinese, Woo Tien (何天) arrested 22-2-33 by the Public
Safety Bureau as being concerned in Communistic activities.

In an upstairs of this address the man Tang Tau
Chien was pointed out by the Chinese P.S.B. detective as
being the man they wanted, named on the warrant.

This man, Tung Tau Chien, claimed to be named,
Tung Hai Tien (陳海天) aged 25, native of Taiwan, being
registered as such at the Japanese Consulate.

D.S.I. Bennett recognised this man as being a
male Chinese, arrested on November 17th 1932 at house
No. Lane 86 Hung Peh Lee (鴻沛里) Sinza Road, suspected
Communist. (Miscellaneous report 196/32 Sinza) subsequently
being released on the guarantee of Mr. Arai that he
was registered as a Japanese subject at the Japanese
Consulate.

政治部登记处
v. D 4546
D. 24/2 p.3
杂项第84号
“B”

协助公安局。            新闸
                        1933年2月23日

1.

1933年2月23日晚8时45分，根据冯法官应公安局要求签发的第6978/9号特别地方法院搜查证，副督察长贝内特（D.S.I. Bennett）、副督察楚拉卡纳基（D.S. Tchourakhanaky）及一队侦探，在公安局王美俊（Wong Yung Chuan）的陪同下，搜查了福煦路外东兴里209号房产，试图逮捕一名因系共产党员而被中国当局通缉的陈少馆（Tung Tau Chien，音译）。

此人陈少馆受一名中国男子胡天（Woo Tien，原文误作何天）牵连，胡天于33年2月22日被公安局逮捕，涉嫌从事共产主义活动。

在该地址的二楼，公安局华籍侦探指认陈少馆即为搜查证上所列的通缉对象。

此人陈少馆自称名叫陈海天（Tung Hai Tien），25岁，台湾人，并在日本领事馆以此身份登记。

副督察长贝内特认出此人即为1932年11月17日在新闸路鸿沛里86弄（原文不清）号被捕的中国男子，当时涉嫌为共产党员。（见新闸捕房196/32号杂项报告），随后因新井先生（Mr. Arai）担保其在日本领事馆登记为日本臣民而获释。

Miscellaneous No. 34.
"BP"
Simsa
Feb. 23rd,
33.

Assistance to Public
Safety Bureau.

1. continued.

Shing Lee, Avenue Foch.

Tung Hai Tien (陳海天) voluntarily came to Simsa
Station for the purpose of enquiries and verification of
previous report re his arrest.

Public Safety Bureau detectives stated that under
the circumstances that this man was registered as a
Japanese subject they did not wish him to be handed over
to them.

Mr. Givens A.C. Political informed, who stated
no action should be preferred against the man Tung Hai
Tien under the circumstances that the Chinese Authorities
did not wish him to be handed over to them.

Tung Hai Tien left station at 10.15 p.m. 23-2-33.

A.C. Political.

（批：Copy of statement obtained from Tung Hai Tien.）
（批：S2, Please arrange through Supt. Tam to obtain a detailed statement from Mr. Tung in connection with the allegation that Tung San Chin is a Communist. What steps are being taken in regard to this matter should be taken up with Mr. O'Keeffe.）

杂项第34号
“BP”
新闸
1933年2月23日

协助公安局。

1. 续。

福煦路东兴里。

陈海天（Tung Hai Tien）自愿来到新闸捕房接受询问，并核实此前关于其被捕的报告。

公安局侦探表示，鉴于此人登记为日本臣民，他们不希望将其移交给他们。

已通知政治部助理处长季文思先生（Mr. Givens），他表示鉴于中国当局不希望移交此人，不应对陈海天采取进一步行动。

陈海天于33年2月23日晚10时15分离开捕房。

助理处长（政治部）。

（批注：陈海天陈述书副本已获取。）
（批注：S2，请通过谭警司安排，从陈先生处获取一份关于指控陈少铨为共产党员的详细陈述。针对此事应采取何种步骤，应与奥基夫先生商议。）
